description: Bounded readiness preflight for Florida DCF's official Listing of all child care providers workbook.
retry: No retries, redirects, alternate hosts, workbook body, provider search, profile detail, or record request.
checkpoint: Two official DCF pages and one exact XLSX HEAD response are validated; the workbook body is never requested.
idempotency: Each observation uses a unique UUID directory and exclusive-create artifacts.
cancellation: Abort is checked before every request, while reading each bounded page, and before publication.
retention_profile: Official publication statements and workbook response headers only; zero provider rows, addresses, contacts, ZIP observations, or coordinates.
